title: Why Africa will lead the next wave of tech innovation

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Africa is skipping the old tech rules and building something new — right now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Young entrepreneurs are solving real problems with limited resources — and fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They're creating mobile-first tech that works where internet is spotty and phones are cheap.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Apps like M-Pesa have revolutionized banking for 30 million users with just a basic phone.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This shift is empowering millions, from farmers to small businesses, with real tools.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The next big tech innovations won’t come from Silicon Valley — they’ll come from Africa.
